content:
The Mathlib Initiative is happy to announce The Meta Café, a weekly metaprogramming gathering for learning through discussion!

@Thomas Murrills will be hosting, and will help to facilitate conversation, experimentation, and collaborative exploration. They will also act as at least one source of knowledge for the group.

The goal of these meetings will be to cultivate metaprogramming insight and skills, from foundational understanding of the "moving parts" of metaprogramming to arcane secrets, and to provide exposure to parts of metaprogramming where you might not know where to begin.

These meetings will be low-stakes and informal, while still providing a chance to engage with deep aspects of metaprogramming. You don't need to be stuck on a specific metaprogramming problem to attend—just bring your curiosity! And also, of course, your tea, coffee, or other beverage…next Wednesday, 2026-04-22T12:00:00-04:00.

See you there! :coffee::croissant:

Google Calendar • iCal • Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/nxr-kaho-yoj
Reminder that the Meta Café opens its virtual doors tomorrow, 2026-04-22T12:00:00-04:00! :) :tea:
The immutable beans have been ground, and the coffee is brewing...the Meta Café opens in 15 minutes. :coffee: :)

Thanks so much to everyone who came; it was great to meet many new people! :tea:

Next time, we'll build an example tactic together and get some hands-on experience with the friendlier entry points to metaprogramming like macro(_rules), elab, and syntax. :) Excited to see you then!
Discussion thread: #general > Discussion: The Meta Café
The Meta Café opens again in 2 hours at 2026-04-29T12:00:00-04:00! :) :coffee:

Reminder that the Meta Café will begin again in 30 mins! :tea: We'll be talking about Qq, Lean Expressions, and handling them in MetaM, as well as some free-form discussion about advanced topics near the end. :)

Reminder that the Meta Café will begin again, again, in 30 mins! :croissant: We'll be casually discussing niche topics up front, and depending on how that goes, might move to discussing free variables/bound variables/the local context. Hope to see you there :)
Note: the Meta Café tomorrow is cancelled due to the current FRO + MI retreat. :)
Note: the Meta Café will resume tomorrow at the regular time, 2026-05-27T12:00:00-04:00! :) Hope to see you there! :coffee:

The Meta Café opens again today in just under 3 hours at 2026-06-03T12:00:00-04:00! :croissant: We’ll be introducing ourselves to environment extensions and attributes, and working on a real mathlib contribution in the process: making differential geometry notation extensible. See you soon! :tea: https://meet.google.com/nxr-kaho-yoj

Reminder that the Meta Café will be serving again in two hours, at 2026-06-10T12:00:00-04:00! :coffee:

We'll be taking a look at interactive suggestions and code actions, and working on a real code action for changing binder plicities (e.g. {x : Nat} to (x : Nat) and vice-versa). We'll also be opening up the table about halfway through to whatever you'd like to bring to it :) Hope to see you there! https://meet.google.com/nxr-kaho-yoj :croissant:

The Meta Café opens again in two hours, at 2026-06-17T12:00:00-04:00. :) :tea:

This time, we'll be working on upgrading Mathlib's group tactic to handle more situations! We'll be looking at expression normalization with Qq and understanding how to apply a ring-like framework to group. See you soon! :) https://meet.google.com/nxr-kaho-yoj :coffee:

The Meta Café will convene tomorrow at 2026-07-15T12:00:00-04:00 to review setm in #40679! :)

This will be nice a chance both for people to gain familiarity and confidence with reviewing (which we urgently need more of!), and to learn about the fundamentals of tactic writing. This PR/tactic has a really nice mix of simplicity in the final code while still showcasing fundamental API and concepts that are useful more generally—in just over 100 LoC we're touching on syntax, elaboration, metavariables, free variables, and manipulation of the goal.

See you there! :coffee: https://meet.google.com/nxr-kaho-yoj
